ceiling_mw.description: Highest hourly delivered wind in the pilot.
ceiling_mw.title: Ceiling Mw

over_share.description: Fraction of hours where the forecast was above actual.
over_share.title: Over Share

wape.description: Sum |error| / sum actual, as a fraction.

d2_decision_mae.description: Decision run on the same hours as d2_mae.
d2_decision_mae.title: D2 Decision Mae

d2_mae.description: Same-time D-2 run, on the hours it covers; null if it covers none.
d2_mae.title: D2 Mae

CI.description: Point estimate with an approximate 90% moving-block bootstrap interval.
CI.title: CI

a.description: Correction intercept: corrected = a + b * raw.
a.title: A

anyOf.description: Walk-forward percentiles of actual/corrected; q[i] is P(i+1), ascending.

gain.description: corrected_mae - raw_mae; negative is an improvement.

n_days.description: Non-calibrating days; all three CIs are paired on them.
n_days.title: N Days

anyOf.description: Walk-forward percentiles of actual/corrected; q[i] is P(i+1), ascending.

diff.description: MAE(to_slot) - MAE(from_slot), paired; negative means waiting helped.

last_slot_id.description: Latest slot published before this gate on D-1.
last_slot_id.title: Last Slot Id

hi_mw.description: null for the open-ended top bin.
hi_mw.title: Hi Mw

days.description: Delivery days of the January pilot.
days.title: Days

excluded_day.description: NESO IT-failure day, optionally excluded from firm stats.
excluded_day.title: Excluded Day

fallback_bins.description: per_level only: bins that fell back to the pooled quantile.
fallback_bins.title: Fallback Bins

firm_pct.description: Firm wind as a fraction of the raw forecast.
firm_pct.title: Firm Pct

cutoff_local.description: Resolved local cutoff on D-1, before the margin.
cutoff_local.title: Cutoff Local

margin.description: Data-latency margin in minutes subtracted from the cutoff.
margin.title: Margin

persistence_mw.description: Last delivered wind known before the cutoff.
persistence_mw.title: Persistence Mw

runs.description: Every run published D-2 00:00 to D-1 23:59 local.
runs.title: Runs

mean_diff_mw.description: mean(N2EX run - EPEX run) over the day's hours.
mean_diff_mw.title: Mean Diff Mw

correction_avg_mw.description: mean(corrected - raw); negative lowers the forecast.
correction_avg_mw.title: Correction Avg Mw

too_late.description: Published at or after the cutoff.
too_late.title: Too Late

values.description: Aligned to Replay.hours; null where the run has no value.
values.title: Values

hours_ahead_min.description: Lead from publish time to the first delivery hour, h.
hours_ahead_min.title: Hours Ahead Min

Sig.description: A deterministic signal; the frontend renders the sentence from id + params.
Sig.title: Sig

auction_diff.description: MAE(N2EX gate run) - MAE(EPEX gate run), paired.

common_hours.description: Hours covered by every slot; all slot metrics use only these.
common_hours.title: Common Hours
